ios.desc:
Teleprompter X – the teleprompter that follows your voice

Read your script, keep eye contact, and get it in one take. Teleprompter X scrolls at your speed or follows your voice. Your scripts stay on your device: no account, no cloud, no tracking.

New in 2.4
	•	Voice scrolling – The script moves when you speak and stops when you stop. Speech recognition runs on your device.
	•	A cleaner design – Bigger text, simpler controls, and a reading line that keeps your place.
	•	Flip & Film on iPhone Duo – Turn the phone around and read your script on the outer screen, right next to the best camera.
	•	Private by design – No sign-in and no analytics. Your scripts never leave your device.

Key Features
	•	Speed or voice scrolling, with a countdown and a talk timer.
	•	HD video recording with a split camera view while you read.
	•	Picture-in-Picture – Keep your script over any app or video call.
	•	Apple Watch app – Control scrolling from your wrist.
	•	Mirror mode for glass teleprompter rigs, plus an external display mode.
	•	Cue Card mode – Break a talk into short, easy prompts.
	•	Adjust fonts, sizes, colours, line spacing and margins.
	•	Import scripts from Files and sort them into folders.
	•	Bluetooth keyboard and game controller support.
	•	Portrait and landscape, on iPhone and iPad, including Split View.

Perfect For
	•	Content creators – Record for YouTube, TikTok and Reels without losing eye contact.
	•	Public speaking – Deliver speeches and presentations with confidence.
	•	Teachers & trainers – Teach on camera without notes in your hand.
	•	Musicians & performers – Keep lyrics and notes in view.

Plans & Payments
	•	Subscription renews unless canceled 24 hours before the end of the current period.
	•	Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.
